The '''Swedlan system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Swedlan]]. It was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. It was governed by the [[Pimbrellan League]].
